responsibility: Defines the x86 runtime CPU-dispatch support helpers shared with libgcc for builtin CPU detection. It declares the processor model records used to store vendor/type/subtype and feature bitsets, provides inline primitives to test/set/reset packed feature bits, and contains the cpuid-based detection routines that classify Intel, AMD, Zhaoxin and other x86 processors, populate feature masks, and derive higher-level built-in predicates such as x86-64-v2/v3/v4 support.
